record.question: What is a major disadvantage of time-of-flight (TOF) MRA, particularly in cases of high-grade stenosis?
options: Venous contamination from the imaging volume.
Overestimation of the severity of stenosis due to signal loss from turbulent flow.
The need for a contrast agent, which increases risk for patients with renal failure.
record.explanation: Answer C: Overestimation of the severity of stenosis due to signal loss from turbulent flow.. TOF MRA can lose signal in turbulent/slow flow, exaggerating stenosis severity. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mri; https://cs.acr.org/-/media/ACR/Files/Radiology-Safety/MR-Safety/Manual-on-MR-Safety.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
